title: Generative AI in Endodontics: A Scoping Review of Applications, Performance, and Limitations
html: Generative artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), has been increasingly studied and applied in endodontics, offering accessible tools for clinical decision support, education, and patient communication without requiring advanced technical expertise. This scoping review aimed to map current applications of LLM-based generative AI in endodontics and to synthesize evidence on their performance, limitations, and key evidence gaps.
